items.title: Does Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) Look Fully Valued After Its 38% Run?
items.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper has delivered a strong share price run over the past year, while also announcing a large equity raise and a planned split into two businesses. The live question is whether that combination leaves the current valuation in line with what its earnings can support. The stock is up about 38.2% over the past year, which puts meaningful pressure on the earnings profile to justify a higher bar for what investors are paying per dollar of profit. items.title: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) Raises $2b In Equity, Is The Stock Fully Valued?
items.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) has just completed a follow on equity offering of about $2 billion, issuing roughly 58 million common shares at $34.50 each to support its upcoming corporate split. The equity raise lands at a time when Keurig Dr Pepper’s share price has been climbing, with a 30 day share price return of 9.72% and a 90 day gain of 15.59%, while the 1 year total shareholder return of 38.21% points to momentum that has been building rather than fading.
